summary: Odometer Flags feature tested end-to-end. Backend: 6/6 pytest pass (arrive response, GET /drivers/:id/stops, /drivers/my-stops, stops-board odometerFlags count, post-trip-end 'Higher than trip end', unauth 401/403). All 4 rules produce the exact strings; exactly-300 mi jump is not flagged; stops with no reading get null. Dashboard: board badge '⚠ N odometer reading(s) to check' (singular/plural right), red highlighted rows with reason, StopsModal flags (opened from both the board and the Drivers page), readable in light and dark mode, unflagged rows unchanged. Regression: board refreshes live on arrival through the socket, including the new flag and badge. One logic bug: a flagged reading becomes the baseline for the next stop, so a correct reading after a typo gets flagged as a false jump.

minor.issue: A wrong reading is still used as the baseline for the next stop. Reproduced: trip start 20480, stop1 20490 (ok), stop2 20100 (flagged 'Lower than trip start'), stop3 20495, which is a correct reading, got flagged '395 mi since stop 2 — check'. A high typo does the same thing: every correct reading after it gets 'Lower than stop N'. Fix: update `prev` only when the reading was not flagged (or always compare against the last unflagged reading).
flagOdometers runs one Trip.findAll per driver (N+1 queries). Collect all tripIds first and run a single query. Low priority.
Stops with tripId null (arrived with no trip in progress) are compared with each other because null === null. Probably fine, but the comparison may cross different days.

action_items: In flagOdometers, keep the last unflagged reading as the baseline (don't set prev from a flagged reading), so a single typo doesn't flag the correct readings after it
Optional: batch the Trip lookup for the stops board into one query
critical_code_review_comments: Precedence is start < previous < end > jump. A reading that is both above trip end and a big jump only shows 'Higher than trip end'. That is acceptable.
The late-proof path (stop already arrived, odometer added later) returns flags through listStops and emits stops:changed. Verified.
